description: Southern Provincial Council - Statute of Co-operative Society No. 06 of 2019
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the enactment of a new provincial statute (Statute of Cooperative Society No. 06 of 2019) that establishes a legal and regulatory framework for cooperative societies in the Southern Province. It creates new regulatory requirements, registration procedures, and governance structures, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel or organizational changes.
